Introduction

JL is a Filipino singer under ShowBT Entertainment, a Filipino-based company. He first debuted in the Filipino boy group PLUUS on February 8, 2023, with the release of their first mini-album "+.Y.M." (also known as "PLUUS +.Y.M.", read as Time).

He was a contestant on SBS' survival show Universe League, where he ranked 1st overall, securing his spot as a member of the final group AHOF.

He made his solo debut on June 6, 2025 with the Philippine single "Alon".
